bio: The Old Swan is one of the most famous hotels in Harrogate, North Yorkshire, with a history going back nearly 200 years. Set in 5 acres of peaceful gardens and just a short walk from the town centre, it combines Victorian splendour with contemporary luxury and is the perfect location for a relaxing and enjoying an Afternoon Tea.  From its revolving doors to its famous glass-ceilinged Wedgwood Restaurant, The Old Swan Hotel Harrogate exudes romance and mystery. It was to this tranquil haven that the mistress of crime-writing, Agatha Christie, famously disappeared in 1926, resulting in a public furore over the 11 days that she could not be traced.
